authoritativeNote: Severity/analyticsState represent analytics outcome. qualityState additionally reflects scientific metadata completeness. Governed target coordinates are projected from session-scientific-metadata.csv when explicitly attested. weather and guiding are normalized, downsampled scientific-history projections from session evidence; neither is realtime observatory telemetry.
